payload.core_mechanism_summary: Greedy state transition: if max >= m output 0; else if one positive and one negative, fast-forward the negative by repeatedly adding the positive value; then iteratively add the smaller to the larger until max >= m, with a safety cap.
payload.rationale: The solution deterministically walks through states by always adding the smaller number to the larger, implicitly traversing an optimal path in the state graph. This resembles a depth-first search on the graph of pairs, though it explores only one branch greedily, aligning with a graph search interpretation.
